messages:
maria (partnerships): FYI — StratusGrid sent the final creative package for the cloud marketplace listing + co-branded solution brief. Need a fast pass: logo lockups, color usage, one-line customer quote. Can design/legal/product review by EOD Fri?

thim?: wait typo

tim.design: I'll do logo lockups check. They provided SVG and 2x PNG, but the primary mark has a 3px outer stroke that conflicts with our lockup grid. I'll mock two fixes (thin stroke / inset mask) and upload to Figma.

olivia.marketing: Can we get the hero headline narrowed to 8–10 words? Current draft: `Redwood + StratusGrid: Accelerating inference at scale with cost‑efficient GPU fleets` — suggest shortening.

dan.engineer: Architectural diagram looks fine but their labels use `k8s` — marketplace copy wants full words like "Kubernetes." Also we need a p95 latency number for the listing (marketplace requires performance callouts).

ryan.legal: Quick trademark/legal flag: StratusGrid's brand guide allows co-branding but prohibits reducing clearspace. We'll need them to sign the co-brand addendum and confirm permission to use customer names/quotes in the case study.

maria (partnerships): I'll request the signed addendum and ask for p95 latency + permission to quote the customer. Stratus said ETA for those items is tomorrow.

tim.design: Uploaded two lockup options to Figma: <https://figma.com/file/abcdef/stratus-redwood-lockups>. Option B increases clearspace and removes stroke — I prefer B. :thumbsup:

olivia.marketing: Draft of the 1-pager brief attached. Short sample hero copy:

"Cut inference cost by 40% while improving p95 latency — Redwood + StratusGrid"

Thoughts?

dan.engineer: Add a short caption under the diagram: "Tested on StratusGrid r4 family GPUs, 8x batch." That keeps claims grounded and reproducible.

ryan.legal: Also request this legal boilerplate under any customer quote: "Customer results may vary. See full T&Cs." Marketplace policy asks for hedging.

maria (partnerships): Plan: 1) design finalize lockup (tim) 2) legal co-brand addendum (ryan) 3) product to confirm perf metrics (dan) 4) marketing to finalize copy + one-pager (olivia). Target: publish marketplace listing next Tuesday if green across the board. :rocket:

tim.design: On it — will update figma and post the final export files (SVG + 3 PNG scales) by EOD.

olivia.marketing: I can A/B test two headline variants once metrics arrive. Will prep 1-sentence customer highlight for the case study too.

dan.engineer: I'll grab the p95 numbers from infra and add test harness notes (dataset, model config) for the brief.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Partner marketplace doc checklist due in 48h — <https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist>

maria (partnerships): Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me in thread or call. /remind me to follow up Mon 9am. :phone:

ryan.legal: Noted — will review the addendum ASAP.

(tim.design's figma link and olivia.marketing's draft received 👍 reactions)
